location: The junction leading to the cellar levels
physicalConditions: Maren is carrying a broken cart axle across her shoulders, sustaining pain and strain on her injured leg/shoulder.
The corridor beyond the junction is dark and damp.
A hairline fracture in the masonry has been cleared to allow passage without triggering a trap.
knowledgeEstablished: Elara identified a secondary mechanical trap involving a hidden latch, pulley system, and weight-sensitive trigger beneath the floor slab at the junction.
The trap was bypassed by slipping through a hairline fracture in the wall rather than breaking stone or using magic.
The mechanism is sensitive to uneven weight distribution, vibrations, and sound.
No magical residue was found on the trap mechanism; it relies on raw engineering.
decisionsMade: Elias decided not to force the wall open but to find an architectural gap.
The party chose to slip through the cleared hairline fracture in the masonry.
Maren agreed to hold the axle steady while Elias inspected for alternate routes.
relationshipChanges: Torin expressed approval of the successful bypass.
Maren asserted her competence and ability to manage her injury without slowing the group.
completedActions: Torin led the party through the narrow corridor to the junction.
Elara inspected the floor and identified the hidden trap mechanism.
Elias used quartz dust to reveal energy residue, confirming the trap was mechanical.
The party cleared debris from a hairline fracture in the wall.
The party slipped through the fracture to the other side of the junction without triggering the trap.
Elias stepped back from the wall after bypassing the trap.
Torin assumed a defensive stance with his hand on his sword pommel, scanning the corridor ahead.
Elara stood up and handed Elias a small vial of loose material.
unresolvedImmediateAction: Elias holds a small vial of loose material handed to him by Elara, while Torin maintains watch over the darkened passage beyond the junction. Maren continues to manage her pain while holding the axle.
continuationPosition: The group is positioned at the threshold of the cellar junction, looking toward the darkened corridor beyond where they must choose a route. Maren is managing her pain while holding the axle, and Elara has just handed Elias a vial.
prohibitedRepetition: Repeating the inspection of the floor for the trap mechanism.
Repeating the discovery of the hairline fracture in the wall.
Repeating the act of clearing debris from the fracture.
Repeating the decision to slip through the fracture rather than breaking stone.
